subject: textures DELTA5 plan/ABI: graphics TLS in n2r + bridge BO ownership
body:
Read TASK, lowering compiler ad62ed9e THREAD_STORAGE comment, current bridge TLS recipe, render generic submit. Proposed additive ABI before edits (no production writes yet):
1) n2r_draw_options append uint32_t thread_storage_bytes (max(vs->tls,fs->tls) from compiled plan; 0 default) and uint32_t reserved_tls. Existing field order/version stays; zero preserves v1/v2/v3 bytes.
2) n2r_addresses append uint64_t tls (resolved 4096-aligned BO base; zero when TLS=0). n2r validates bytes<=32768, base nonzero+4096-aligned when bytes>0, and packs ONE MALI_LOCAL_STORAGE at m+832 for both IDVS vertex/secondary and fragment thread_storage pointers: tls_size=ceil_log2(ceil(bytes/16)), PACKED, base>>8, wls_instances=NO_WORKGROUP_MEM, WLS zero. TLS0 leaves the existing descriptor bytes untouched.
3) Bridge ownership (compute owns bridge.c): allocate per=next_pow2(align16(bytes)), total=per*2048*cores (same conservative 2048/core and core mask as compute delta4), 4096-aligned, retain in submit, release after wait/failure; pass a.tls. If allocation/status fails, return BAD before submit; never bind zero TLS with nonzero bytes. This is the only production BO change.
4) Render wiring: store max(vs->tls,fs->tls) in Dispatch, force the v3/n2r path when nonzero even if genericDrawFlags is 0, and refuse if bridge cannot allocate. Render pipeline already carries code[i]->tls.
5) Host tests: TLS 0 byte identity; TLS16/32/64/192 with v9_pack unpack; base>>8/PACKED; same descriptor pointer in DRAW and both SHADER_ENVIRONMENTs; invalid base/oversize refusal with output unchanged; Mesa-bound oracle for shift and per-thread round. No simultaneous WLS (graphics has none).
Limits: exact threads/core still 2048 conservative; TLS memory can be large for 32KiB/thread, root/L4 only. Request compute ACK and bridge field name; render ACK tls source. No phone/native/build/lease.
